uncertaintyReason.partially_supported: only partly supported by the source
uncertaintyReason.unsupported: not supported by the cited passage
uncertaintyReason.unjudgeable: could not be judged against the source
uncertaintyReason.structurally_invalid: not storable: no claim or no source passage

list.heading: Memories
list.error: We couldn't load your memories just now.

bulk.explainer: Bulk changes are consequential. They create a pending approval, not an instant edit.
bulk.requested: Requested: “{{summary}}”. Decide it under <link>Approvals</link>. It runs only after you approve it there.

none.title: Nothing remembered yet
none.body: A memory is a single verifiable fact Cogeto extracted from something you captured. Capture a note above and watch it move through extraction and verification.

filtered.title: No memories match these filters
filtered.body: Try clearing the search or status filter.

drawer.title: Memory
drawer.loadError: This memory couldn't be loaded. It may have been rejected.
drawer.sharedByOwner: This memory is shared with your organization by <owner>{{owner}}</owner>. You can read it, but only its owner can approve, edit, change its scope, or delete it.
drawer.confirmTitle: Your confirmation outranks the machine judgment from here on
drawer.rejectConfirm: Reject and remove this memory? This cannot be undone.
drawer.scopeTitle: Shared facts are visible to everyone in your organization.
drawer.editExplainer: Saving a correction never rewrites history: it records a new, approved version and keeps this one as its predecessor.
drawer.conflictHidden: The conflicting fact is not visible to you (it may have been resolved).

uncertainty.held: <lead>Held as uncertain: </lead>{{reason}}. Cogeto decided this on its own, and cites the fact softly rather than as settled.
uncertainty.wasAdmitted: <lead>Was admitted as uncertain: </lead>{{reason}}. Cogeto decided this on its own, and cites the fact softly rather than as settled.

drawer.noVerification: No verification pass. This version was authored by you.
drawer.sourceOwnerOnly: The source is private to its owner. Deletion is owner-only.
drawer.noCorrections: No corrections. This is the original.

event.party_superseded: a fact was superseded, the finding follows its successor
event.kept_open: kept open, could not be safely closed

drawer.noCitations: No stored answer has cited this fact yet.

capturePointer.body: Capture lives in chat now: tell Cogeto something and use Remember this, or attach a file with the paperclip on <chatLink>the chat page</chatLink>. Deliberate document uploads live on <sourcesLink>the Sources page</sourcesLink>.

search.title: Fact search
search.explainer: A filtered search across every fact Cogeto holds. For the source-first view of what the system knows, use <sourcesLink>Sources</sourcesLink>.
